answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so past endorsements lose weight unless an identity sustains honest service over time. EigenTrust-style centrality propagates through reciprocity-weighted endorsements: a new sybil has no trusted incoming bridge and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality, while sybil-to-sybil praise contributes little. Archived evidence in the vault cannot replace current trust; only repeated verified conduct can climb the terrace of consensus thresholds.
